svg.title: Octo Ramen — eight arms, one perfect bowl
svg.desc: A cheerful coral-colored octopus in a chef's hat runs a tiny teal ramen booth. Eight curling arms juggle a ladle, noodles, a tasting bowl and a steaming bowl of ramen, beneath a red striped awning and a glowing paper lantern. A warm, detailed, vintage-style vector illustration.
